NDT training in Colorado Springs, CO: space, defence and Front Range industry

Short answer: In Colorado Springs, NDT training is split into self-paced online theory, with an ASNT NDT Level III on hand for questions, and a hands-on practical at the employer's own facility. The employer certifies the technician under a written practice built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Colorado Springs. We reply within one business day.

Colorado Springs is known as a military and space city. Fort Carson, Peterson Space Force Base, Schriever Space Force Base, Cheyenne Mountain and the Air Force Academy are all in or near the city, and many large aerospace and defence contractors keep engineering and production sites here. Down the road, Pueblo has a steel mill, and the utility and construction sectors along the Front Range keep structural and pressure-equipment inspection busy. The result is a market where precision, traceability and customer flow-downs matter as much as raw skill.

If you search "ndt training Colorado Springs" or "ndt classes near me", you are probably weighing how to get qualified without leaving a job or a military posting. Most of the learning can happen online, with the hands-on step arranged through your employer. This page explains the route in plain terms.

Ask about NDT training for Colorado Springs. The published US fees table on this page lists the standard courses, and Register & Buy Now opens the course on the Atlantis portal.

How to get NDT certified in Colorado Springs: the SNT-TC-1A sequence

  1. Learn what your employer's written practice demands. A defence contractor, a utility and a steel fabricator will each set different hours and examination rules.
  2. Take the instruction. Check the hours against the training-requirements matrix so your coursework meets the written practice.
  3. Build supervised experience. Practice with a certified Level II or III only counts when it is recorded and signed.
  4. Sit the general examination covering principles, equipment and vocabulary.
  5. Sit the specific examination that tests the employer's procedures, instruments and acceptance limits.
  6. Complete the practical examination on real specimens with known flaws, scored by a Level III or delegate.
  7. Keep eyesight records current, including near acuity and colour contrast.
  8. Receive certification signed by your employer.
  9. Recertify as the written practice directs.

Test your readiness with the eligibility checker and see the training FAQ.

Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 NDT courses for Colorado Springs technicians

Courses follow the SNT-TC-1A body of knowledge. Begin with Level 1, advance to Level 2 once you have logged hours, and consider Level III preparation for programme roles.

MethodWhat the course coversWhere it is used around Colorado Springs
VTWeld and surface inspection, gauges, lighting, reportingSpacecraft and launch hardware fabrication, structural steel, tanks, ground support equipment
MTMagnetising, particle types, field direction, evaluationFerrous machined parts, aircraft ground equipment, steel fabrication, lifting gear
PTCleaning, penetrant application, removal, developer, interpretationTitanium, aluminium and nickel alloy parts, welds on thin-wall assemblies
UTThickness gauging, flaw detection, shear-wave welds, calibrationPressure vessels, power plant piping, forgings, composite and bonded structure
RTExposure technique, image quality, film and digital interpretationCastings, welded assemblies, pressure piping; Colorado radiation rules apply
ETProbe selection, frequency, impedance plane, surface and tubing workAircraft structure, fastener holes, heat-exchanger tubing, precision components
Level III studyASNT Basic and Method topics, procedure writing, programme administrationQuality leads at defence suppliers, utilities and fabricators

PAUT and TOFD are advanced options for UT Level II technicians, and in aerospace the customer specification controls whether they can be used.

Ultrasonic testing (UT) training in Colorado Springs

Aerospace and defence customers use UT on forgings, plate, bar, bonded joints and composite structure. Utilities and fabricators use it for thickness and weld work. A person searching "ultrasonic testing training Colorado Springs" may be heading into either camp, and the course gives them the shared fundamentals before specialising.

UT Level I and II cover sound propagation, probe types, couplant, calibration blocks, distance-amplitude correction, attenuation and sizing techniques, then teach how to write an inspection record that a customer quality engineer can accept. Candidates learn to distinguish true flaws from geometry echoes, and why altitude, temperature and surface roughness can influence setups. Prime contractors often supply their own procedures, and the written practice must reconcile them.

Prepare with the UT Level 2 practice questions and the UT course page, and practise probe positioning in the Practical NDT simulator.

Where NDT technicians work around Colorado Springs

Space and defence. Peterson and Schriever Space Force Bases, Cheyenne Mountain and the Air Force Academy anchor the military presence, and several large defence and aerospace contractors keep engineering or production sites in the area. Their supplier chains inspect machined, welded and composite hardware with PT, MT, UT and ET.

Army and installation support. Fort Carson supports vehicle and aviation maintenance and a large installation infrastructure, with weld and structural inspection requirements on equipment and facilities.

Steel and heavy industry. A rail and steel mill in Pueblo, about forty-five miles south, and fabricators along the Front Range need VT, MT and UT on structural and pressure components.

Power and utilities. The city-owned utility and other generators and gas suppliers along the Front Range operate boilers, piping, tanks and transmission structures that need periodic inspection under ASME and owner standards.

Mining. Gold mining near Cripple Creek and aggregate and cement operations in the region use structural, pressure and rotating equipment that is checked with VT, MT and UT.

Construction and transportation. I-25 corridor bridges, high-rise steel and industrial construction create demand for weld VT, with UT and RT on bigger projects under AWS D1.1 and D1.5.

NDT schools and classes near Colorado Springs: what to compare

An "ndt school near me" search around Colorado Springs shows community college offerings, private trainers and providers in Denver. Fixed classroom courses suit people who want structure and equipment access. Self-paced study suits personnel with irregular shifts, spouses of service members who move often, and workers on contracts in remote locations. Whichever you pick, the certificate that matters is the one your employer signs.

Ask every provider these questions:

  • Which edition of SNT-TC-1A does the syllabus follow?
  • Who writes and grades the practical?
  • Will defence and aerospace employers accept the record?
  • Does it help with customer procedures, not only general theory?
  • How long do I keep access to materials?
  • Are all fees public?

At Atlantis, theory is online and self-paced with Level III Q&A, and access begins the moment you enrol. The simulator offers practice between modules, and the practical is carried out at the employer's own facility. Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Colorado Springs, so nothing ties you to one location, which helps if your job or posting moves.

Online NDT training in Colorado

Yes, the theory can be completed online in Colorado. Self-paced modules cover Level I and II for each method, and Level III preparation covers the Basic and Method topics. Shift workers, mountain-town contractors and people relocating between bases all benefit from studying where and when they can. The practical remains in person with real equipment and a grader.

See online NDT training and the Colorado overview. Nearby: Denver, Albuquerque, Wichita and Salt Lake City.

Training a crew at your Colorado Springs facility

Employers here often need to qualify new technicians quickly, align a written practice with prime-contractor requirements, or prepare for a customer audit. We support that in four ways.

  • Written practice development aligned with the methods you use and the flow-downs your customers apply. See written practice development.
  • Online theory for the crew, which leaves production uninterrupted.
  • On-site practical examinations using your parts and procedures.
  • Outside Level III support when no in-house Level III exists. See Level III consulting.

Under SNT-TC-1A the employer certifies. See corporate NDT training or ask about onsite training for your Colorado Springs team.

Radiography licensing in Colorado

Colorado is an NRC Agreement State. The Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment regulates radioactive materials, including sources used in industrial radiography, and licences set training, supervision and safety requirements. A radiography course teaches technique but does not license anyone to handle a source.

Radiographers in Colorado typically hold regulatory radiation safety credentials plus RT method certification from the employer. Confirm what applies to your job with the department and your employer.

Practise before your practical exam

The Practical NDT simulator provides twelve method families across twelve workplaces, including an aircraft hangar, a welding workshop and an NDT lab. You can repeat setups, scan coverage and interpretation until they are second nature. It does not replace logged experience or the practical on real specimens.

Use the NDT practice tests for written revision by method.

Defence and space customers: what changes for a technician

Technicians who move from general industry into a defence or space supplier often find that the NDT is the same but the surrounding discipline is stricter. Procedures are controlled documents and you are expected to follow the revision on the shop floor. Instruments are calibrated and tagged, and you must show the record. Parts carry serial numbers, and the inspection report must tie to them. Customer representatives may witness examinations.

Those expectations show up in the written practice, which usually adds requirements beyond the SNT-TC-1A baseline. A Level III reconciles both. Candidates who understand why the rules exist, and can explain them in an interview, are noticeably easier to hire. Our courses spend time on records and procedure control for that reason, and the practical examination at your employer's facility is where those habits are checked.

Getting started without a local employer

Some readers searching for NDT training in Colorado Springs have not yet found an employer. That is workable. You can complete the Level 1 theory for the methods you are most likely to use, practise in the simulator, and take the practice tests to see where you are weak. When you approach a defence supplier, utility or fabricator, you can show a completed training record and a clear plan rather than a general interest.

Expect most employers to start you as a trainee, because certification cannot be issued until the employer has examined you under its own written practice. Make a habit of keeping a personal copy of your training certificates, course outlines and any logged hours, since a future employer may ask for them. Transitioning military personnel who already have inspection or maintenance experience should list it plainly, because some of it may count toward the experience hours a written practice requires, subject to the employer's review.

Your instructor

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in Colorado Springs

How do I become an NDT technician in Colorado Springs?

Study the Level 1 theory, then look to defence suppliers, fabricators, utilities and contractors that run an SNT-TC-1A programme. Begin as a trainee, log supervised hours and pass the employer's examinations.

Are there NDT jobs in Colorado Springs?

Yes, in space and defence manufacturing, military installation support, utilities, steel and construction. Employers ask for current certification, a documented written practice and full records.

Is there an NDT school near me in Colorado Springs?

Other providers serve the Front Range, but Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Colorado Springs. Our theory is online and the practical is at the employer's facility.

How much does NDT training cost in Colorado Springs?

The published US fees table on this page shows the standard courses. Crews and custom needs are quoted on request, and we reply within one business day.

Can military personnel and spouses study online?

The self-paced theory works from anywhere, which suits frequent moves. The practical must be arranged with an employer that has a written practice.

Which method should I learn first?

Visual, penetrant and magnetic particle testing are common starting points, followed by ultrasonic and eddy current as experience grows.

Does my certificate transfer to another employer?

Not automatically. The next employer reviews your evidence and certifies you under its own written practice.

Do I need a licence for radiography in Colorado?

A Colorado radiography company must hold the state licence, and its radiographers have to meet the training and safety conditions attached to it. RT method certification is a different matter.

Can you prepare me for Level III?

Yes, self-paced online for the Basic and Method topics. See Level III training.
